mnemonics.description: Key memory triggers for Prelims facts.

items.title: P.A.V.E
items.decryption: Remember these four pillars of the Gupta cultural revival: Compiling Puranas, Classical Art, Vaishnava patronage, and finalizing the Mahabharata/Ramayana.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Mistaking Gupta tolerance for lack of patronage; while tolerant, the state was distinctly Brahmanical.
Assuming Buddhism declined entirely; it thrived in universities like Nalanda during this period.
Confusing the Bhakti movement (medieval) with Gupta-era devotionalism (early roots).

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Tenets

  • Revival of Vedic rituals (Ashvamedha)
  • Rise of Pauranic Hinduism
  • Religious tolerance

Cultural Icons

  • Kalidasa (Literature)
  • Varahamihira (Science)
  • Aryabhata (Mathematics)
  • Religion:
    • Vaishnavism: The 'State Religion' (Gupta kings as Parama-Bhagavatas).
    • Buddhism: Flourished; Nalanda University foundation.
  • Art and Architecture:
    • Nagara Style: Beginning of temple architecture (Deogarh, Bhitargaon).
    • Painting: Ajanta Cave frescos (Cave 16 & 17).
